screen.infinite_player_visibility.title: Infinite Player Visibility
screen.infinite_player_visibility.subtit: Client screen. Copy the same config to the server for multiplayer.
option.infinite_player_visibility.remote: Caps remote rendering to loaded terrain range so players and entities do not appear in unloaded space.
Uses only this mod's visibility distance, even beyond loaded terrain.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.infinite_: Keeps distant players and server-ticking entities visible without loading their chunks.
